name: stud_is_not_a_hole
why: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW OF 27/9/2026, finding on the studs. A hole in the view from above is a circle that is the inner ring of a planar face: but so is the FOOT of a stud, because the face of the plate surrounds it. The foot of a Ø20 stud 20 high on a 120 x 80 x 10 plate could be taken for a blind hole «Ø20 ↧20» with its position dimensions. Now: if the wall that starts from the circle rises OUT of the face (against the normal of the planar face) it is a stud, and has a diameter dimension.
defect_caught: A stud called out as a blind hole; a hole that is in the drawing and not in the part.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V2 from above (the stud as a circle).

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 96000 plus pi x 10^2 x 20

expect.why: the foot of the stud is not a hole
the stud has its own diameter dimension, re-read
